spans.s:
Seeing.
2

Attention, observation.
E.
अव and ईक्षण seeing.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Inspecting, examining.
E.
अव, ईक्ष to see, शानच् aff.

f. (-क्षा)
1 Attention, observation.
2 Seeing, looking at.
3 Agreement, engagement.
E.
अव upon or to, ईक्ष to see, अ affix, and टाप् feminine.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Seen, regarded.
E.
अव before ईक्ष and क्त aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Not enquiring or ascertaining.
E.
अ neg. विद to know, शानच् aff.

m. (-विद्)
A Brahman who has not studied the Vedas.
E.
अ neg. वेद and विद् who knows.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Unscriptural, not enjoined in the Vedas.
E.
अ neg. वेद and विहित declared.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
1 Unascertainable, secret, not to be known.
2 Not to be pained or hurt.
m. (-द्यः)
A calf.
E.
अ neg. वेद्य to be hurt or known.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
To be represented or made known.
ind.
Having made known.
E.
आङ् before विद् to know, causal form, यत् or ल्यप् aff.

m. (-लः)
Denial or concealment of knowledge.
f. (-ला)
Chewed betel.
E.
अव and इला speech.

m. (-गः)
1 Hurry, haste.
2 Flurry, agitation.
f. (-गी)
A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.)
E.
आङ् before विज to be alarmed, घञ् and ङीप् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
One who makes known.
m. (-कः)
1 An appellant, a suitor.
2 An informer.
E.
आङ् before विद to know, causal form, वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
Representing, addressing or apprising respectfully.
E.
आङ् and वेदन informing.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Made known, communicated, represented.
E.
आङ् before विद to know, causal form, क्त aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Stating, representing.
E.
आङ् before विद to know, causal form, शानच् aff.

m. (-शः)
1 Entrance, entering.
2 Pride, arrogance.
3 Indistinctness of idea, apoplectic or epileptic giddiness.
4 Absorption of the faculties in one wish or idea, devotedness to an object.
5 Demoniac frenzy, possession, &c.
E.
आङ् before विश to enter, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Entrance, entering.
2 A house in which work is carried on, a workshop, a manufactory, &c.
3 Possession by devils, &c.
4 Passion, fury.
5 The disk of the sun.
E.
आङ्, विश to enter, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
1 A guest, a visiter.
2 Entering into.
3 Own, peculiar, unparticipated.
4 Inherent.
E.
आङ्, विश to enter, ठक् aff.

m. (-कः)
A wall, a fence, an enclosure.
E.
आङ्, वेष्ट to surround, वुन् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Wrapping round, binding, tying.
2 A wrapper, an envelope, a bandage.
3 An inclosure.
E.
आङ् before वेष्ट to surround, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Surrounded, enveloped, inclosed, bound or tied.
E.
आङ् before वेष्ट to inclose, क्त aff.
